title: Deterministic Memory Fusion for Long-Horizon Conversational Agents

contributions.purpose: Consolidate redundant conversational memory without the cost, latency, and non-determinism of LLM-guided fusion.
contributions.mechanism: DFM-Fusion, a deterministic four-stage pipeline: sentence segmentation, near-duplicate removal via embedding similarity, MMR-based sentence packing within a token budget, and salient-token coverage verification.
contributions.evaluation: Quote-preserving operator that eliminates all LLM calls from memory consolidation while maintaining verbatim fidelity (removes all 226 fusion-related LLM calls per run).
contributions.source_quote: A deterministic, quote-preserving fusion operator that eliminates all LLM calls from memory consolidation while maintaining verbatim information fidelity.

contributions.purpose: Show the deterministic operator matches LLM-guided fusion in quality.
contributions.mechanism: Evaluate on the LoCoMo long-term memory benchmark against LLM-guided fusion.
contributions.evaluation: Statistical equivalence to LLM-guided fusion on multi-hop F1 (18.72 vs 18.63, p=0.864) with 106.4% gap recovery.
contributions.source_quote: Empirical validation on LoCoMo showing statistical equivalence to LLM-guided fusion (multi-hop F1: 18.72 vs 18.63, p=0.864) with 106.4% gap recovery.

contributions.purpose: Quantify the operational advantages of removing the LLM from fusion.
contributions.mechanism: Measure runtime, API-call count, and auditability of DFM-Fusion versus LLM-guided fusion.
contributions.evaluation: 5.23x speedup in memory maintenance, 100% elimination of fusion API calls, and fully auditable fusion logic.
contributions.source_quote: Practical benefits including 5.23x speedup in memory maintenance, 100% elimination of fusion API calls, and fully auditable fusion logic.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We propose DFM-Fusion (Deterministic FadeMem-Fusion), a four-stage pipeline that replaces LLM-guided fusion with fully deterministic outputs.

We propose DFM-Fusion (Deterministic FadeMem-Fusion), a fully deterministic replacement for LLM-guided memory fusion in long-horizon conversational agents. Our approach maintains the memory architecture and retrieval mechanisms of existing systems while eliminating all LLM calls from the fusion operator.
Our work demonstrates that deterministic fusion can match LLM-guided approaches on these challenging benchmarks.

notes: TIE/EQUIVALENCE-RESULT paper: headline claim is statistical equivalence (not superiority) to LLM-guided fusion on multi-hop F1 (18.72 vs 18.63, p=0.864, non-significant); value is framed as efficiency/determinism/auditability rather than accuracy gains. Positioned as a deterministic replacement for FadeMem's (Wei et al. 2026) LLM-guided fusion; absolute F1 scores are low (~18.7).
